title: Is F45 Worth It in NZ? — Honest Review for 2026
meta_desc: Is F45 worth it in NZ? Explore F45 pricing, results, and contract terms in our honest review
intro: With over 30 locations across New Zealand, F45 has become a popular choice for those seeking a high-intensity workout. But with prices starting from $60 per week, is it worth the investment? We'll dive into the details to help you decide.

sections.heading: F45 Pricing in NZ
sections.body: F45 offers a range of membership options, with prices varying depending on the location and commitment term. The most popular option is the 12-month contract, which costs $60 per week. A 6-month contract is also available for $70 per week, while a month-to-month option costs $80 per week.

sections.heading: Contract Terms and Conditions
sections.body: It's essential to understand the contract terms before signing up. F45's 12-month contract requires a minimum commitment of 12 months, with a 30-day notice period for cancellations. The 6-month contract has a 14-day notice period, while the month-to-month option can be cancelled at any time with 30 days' notice.

sections.heading: Who is F45 Best For?
sections.body: F45 is an excellent choice for those seeking a high-intensity, functional workout with a strong focus on community and accountability. It's ideal for individuals who enjoy group training and are willing to commit to a regular schedule.

sections.heading: Is F45 Worth It?
sections.body: Ultimately, whether F45 is worth it depends on your individual fitness goals and budget. If you value the high-energy atmosphere and personalized attention, F45 may be a worthwhile investment. However, if you're on a tight budget or prefer a more flexible workout routine, alternative options like Les Mills or Jetts may be more suitable.

sections.heading: Find an F45 Gym Near You
sections.body: With locations in Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, and more, there's likely an F45 gym near you. Visit the F45 website or check out our gym guide for more information on F45 locations and pricing.
